name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email builds its link from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment. That explains the localhost links users are seeing after the last release (likely a missing/changed env var in production config, not a code typo). Fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in all production environments, and/or make templates.ts fail loudly (throw or log an error) instead of silently defaulting to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is missing, so misconfiguration is caught before emails go out.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this value is used to build the password reset link (as well as the rollup and export links). If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, users receive reset emails pointing at localhost, which matches the reported behavior.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production deployment configuration, and/or make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) instead of silently defaulting to localhost when running outside development, so misconfiguration is caught before emails go out.
